scenarios.name: Add cancellationReason to Order
scenarios.description: Add a new optional field to the Order domain entity
scenarios.objective: Implement a new domain field across all architectural layers (domain → API → state management → UI)
scenarios.prompt:
The Order entity needs a new optional field called 'cancellationReason' (string, nullable). This field should:
1. Be added to the Order domain model
2. Be persisted in the database (if applicable)
3. Be exposed through API endpoints that return orders
4. Be available in the UI for display
5. Have appropriate tests

Implement this change end-to-end. If you're uncertain about the exact implementation, look at similar fields and follow the same pattern.
success_criteria: The new field is accessible from external API

scenarios.name: Rename AuthenticationService to IdentityService
scenarios.description: Refactor: rename a core service and update all references
scenarios.objective: Rename AuthenticationService to IdentityService across the entire codebase
scenarios.prompt:
Find the AuthenticationService class and rename it to IdentityService. Update all imports, instantiations, type annotations, and configuration references throughout the codebase to use the new name.

Do NOT change the functionality—this is purely a rename operation. Ensure:
1. All tests still pass
2. Code builds successfully
3. No references to the old name remain (except in git history/comments)
success_criteria: No references to 'AuthenticationService' remain in active code
